news.headline: TD Cowen keeps Buy on Forgent, lowers price target to $55 from $76
news.summary: A day after fiscal Q1 results, TD Cowen kept its Buy rating but cut its target to $55 from $76, pointing to FY2027 bookings timing. Even after the cut, the target sits well above the low-$20s share price.

news.headline: Forgent shares slide despite Q1 beat as FY27 guidance midpoint trails estimates
news.summary: Despite record revenue of $478.6M (+69%) and adjusted EPS of $0.24 vs. $0.20 consensus, the stock fell as the raised fiscal 2027 revenue range of $2.45B-$2.65B had a midpoint below Street expectations. The stock was already down about 42% over the past month amid the data-center sell-off.

news.headline: Forgent Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Results Above High End of Guidance; Raises Full-Year Outlook on Strong Commercial and Operational Execution
news.summary: Fiscal Q1 revenue rose 69% to a record $479M with adjusted EBITDA of $105M (21.9% margin), net income of $55M and $136M of operating cash flow, all above the top of guidance. Forgent raised FY2027 guidance to $2.45-2.65B revenue and $587-637M adjusted EBITDA, with backlog covering 100% of the revenue guide.

news.headline: JP Morgan keeps Overweight on Forgent, lowers price target to $35 from $49
news.summary: On the eve of fiscal Q1 results, JP Morgan kept its Overweight rating but cut its target to $35 from $49, tracking the roughly 40% one-month slide in the shares. The new target still sits well above the low-$20s share price.

news.headline: Forgent Power Solutions (FPS) is soaring double digits ahead of earnings
news.summary: FPS rose about 16% on November 9 to close at $22.60, rebounding from a new 52-week low set the previous Friday as investors bought the dip. The bounce came ahead of the November 12 fiscal Q1 report, which the company has already said will beat the top of its revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance.

news.headline: Roth/MKM Starts Forgent Power Solutions (FPS) at Buy
news.summary: Roth/MKM initiated coverage with a Buy rating just ahead of fiscal Q1 results. The stock had hit a new 52-week low the day before, after a roughly 33% pullback.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q2 2027 results
catalysts.detail: First quarterly check against the raised FY2027 guide of $2.45-2.65B revenue and $587-637M adjusted EBITDA; watch order intake and backlog conversion.

catalysts.label: Columbus office ramp
catalysts.detail: New 90,000 sq ft Columbus, Ohio office adding 85 jobs in support functions.

catalysts.label: Tijuana Powertrain expansion online
catalysts.detail: Expected to raise total revenue capacity to about $5.8B.

pulse: Forgent beat on Nov 12 with record fiscal Q1 revenue of $479M (+69%) and adjusted EBITDA of $105M (21.9% margin), and raised its FY2027 guide to $2.45-2.65B revenue and $587-637M adjusted EBITDA; backlog already covers the full-year revenue guide, and about 40% of it runs into FY2028. The shares still fell on Nov 12 because the guidance midpoint trailed estimates and bookings timing worried investors, extending a ~40% one-month drawdown after the October CFO exit. Analysts are trimming targets but staying positive (TD Cowen Buy, cut to $55 from $76 on Nov 13; JPMorgan Overweight $35; Roth/MKM Buy). Fiscal Q2 results around February are the next test of bookings momentum.
